SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
(replacement for the two 404ing Anthropic URLs in sources.json)
SCANNED: 2026-08-30
NEWEST: 2026-08-27

- 2026-08-27: Python SDK 1.2.0, TypeScript 0.122.0, Go 1.68.0, Java 2.59.0, Ruby 1.67.0, C# 12.44.0 -
  `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` no longer send the `files-api-2025-04-14` and `skills-2025-10-02`
  beta headers and return the same shapes as `client.files` / `client.skills`. `client.beta.skills.delete()` now
  deletes a Skill together with all of its versions. Beta Messages type `BetaSkill` renamed `BetaContainerSkill`.
  Requests still sending the beta headers keep the beta shapes.
  ASSESSMENT: SDK shape migration, not a new capability. Below reporting bar.

- 2026-08-26 and earlier: item-for-item unchanged from the 2026-08-27 scan.
  (Compliance API session endpoints GA; local session endpoints return claude_science and office_agents/*;
  Admin API in the `ant` CLI and seven SDKs under client.beta.organization.)

Date headings present: Aug 27, 26, 20, 19, 18, 11, 10, 7, 5, 3, 1; then July 24, 22, 17, 15, 14, 10, 8, 2, 1.
